item.title: Lando Norris on pole for Hungarian GP
item.description: McLaren’s British driver Lando Norris celebrates winning the pole position after the qualifying session at the Hungaroring racetrack in Mogyorod near Budapest, Hungary, on July 25, 2026 ahead of the Formula One Hungarian Grand Prix.

item.title: DSV to deploy 10 Windrose electric semi trucks on I-35 corridor (allegedly)
item.description: The electric semi truck market seems to be heating up in Texas, with Wen Han’s upstart Windrose brand set to deploy 10 fully electric Class 8 trucks on the I-35 freight corridor between Dallas and Laredo en route to Mexico.

item.title: E-quipment highlight: Avant Tecno e727 electric wheel loader
item.description: Increasingly volatile fuel prices are making electric equipment options a need, rather than a want for many fleets, and Avant Tecno is working to meet that need with the new e727 electric wheel loader – the company’s largest offering in North America .
